vacancies.title: Thermal Analysis and Verification Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strongest direct ESA match; highly relevant thermal analysis and verification work. Main stretch is professional spacecraft thermal experience and ESATAN-TMS.

vacancies.title: Junior Small Satellites Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Excellent broad early-career spacecraft role with subsystem design, requirements, verification and AIT/AIV exposure.

vacancies.title: Senior Small Satellites Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Current Telespazio senior Small Satellites role at ESTEC, covering subsystem design, requirements, verification, launch preparation and industrial monitoring. Strong technical alignment, but the senior positioning and expected prior spacecraft systems experience make it a meaningful stretch.

vacancies.title: Systems Engineer for Space Sustainability
vacancies.assessment: Broad ESA systems/R&D work with CDF studies and technology activities; mechanically accessible but requires specific Clean Space, Zero Debris and sustainability-engineering knowledge.

vacancies.title: End-to-End System Engineer
vacancies.assessment: ESTEC systems/test-lab exposure is attractive, but the role is dominated by Linux, Kubernetes, C++/Java/Python and distributed simulation infrastructure.

vacancies.title: Senior Human Spaceflight Safety Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Very interesting human-spaceflight safety and verification work at ESTEC, but it requires proven spaceflight-safety certification and dependability expertise and is explicitly senior.

vacancies.title: Industrialisation Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Outstanding technical match for a mechanical/manufacturing generalist, but the direct Telespazio vacancy page states that the position is closed and no longer accepting candidates.

vacancies.title: GNC-AOCS Sensors and Actuators Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strong hardware/test relevance at ESTEC: AOCS sensor and actuator procurement, laboratory characterization, verification/validation, test plans, GSE and AIT/AIV support. The main stretch is the requested 4+ years of dedicated AOCS/GNC experience and control/aerospace specialization.

vacancies.title: Solar Generators Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strong ESTEC hardware role spanning electrical and mechanical solar-array design, thermo-mechanical properties, manufacturing, qualification, laboratory testing and R&D, but the direct Telespazio page now states that the position is closed.

vacancies.title: Space Solar Array & Generator Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Relevant mechanical and thermo-mechanical spacecraft hardware work; specific solar-array experience is the main gap.

vacancies.title: Navigation System Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Legitimate ESTEC systems-engineering role covering requirements, segment interfaces, reviews and verification for Galileo. Broad systems content is relevant, but dedicated GNSS/Galileo knowledge and software-heavy analysis make it a substantial domain stretch.

vacancies.title: On-Board Computers and Data Handling Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Strong ESTEC laboratory, hardware-integration, verification and R&D exposure, including CubeSat and avionics test facilities. Main mismatch is the requirement for dedicated on-board-computer/data-handling expertise, preferably 7+ years.

vacancies.title: Microelectronics Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Includes qualification, laboratory testing, R&D and hardware-development support at ESTEC, but the core discipline is ASIC/FPGA/microelectronics and therefore well outside the mechanical profile. Included for high recall.

vacancies.title: Satellite Telecommunication System Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC system-analysis and R&D role with useful ESA exposure, but strongly specialized in satellite communications, 5G protocols and network simulation rather than mechanical engineering.

vacancies.title: AIT & Production Engineer for IRIS2
vacancies.assessment: Strong ESTEC hardware route covering satellite AIT, production readiness, manufacturing flows and interfaces with hardware teams. Mechanical Engineering is explicitly relevant; the main stretch is the requested prior satellite AIT/AIV experience.

vacancies.title: Space PA/QA Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Good hardware/process fit with mechanical manufacturing, qualification, inspection and ECSS/PA exposure; some PA/QA experience stretch.

vacancies.title: System AIT Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Technically attractive AIT role with strong hardware exposure, but 7+ years AIT requirement is a major stretch.

vacancies.title: Electrical/Functional AIT Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Engineering-heavy AIT at spacecraft level, but the role is predominantly electrical/functional rather than mechanical and asks for prior AIT experience.

vacancies.title: PA and Safety Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Relevant ESA PA/Safety domain, but the formal requirement of extensive dedicated space PA/QA experience makes this a very large stretch.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Technician
vacancies.assessment: Excellent ESTEC hardware proximity but significant under-leveling for an MSc engineer; mostly machining, assembly, inspection and workshop support.

vacancies.title: E2E Performance Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Relevant verification and mission-engineering content, but optical-instrument and software-heavy requirements are significant mismatches.

vacancies.title: Sentinel System Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Broad spacecraft engineering is relevant, but the 10+ years experience requirement makes this a substantial stretch.

vacancies.title: Power Management Engineer (2 positions)
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA and hardware-oriented, but fundamentally an electrical power systems role.

vacancies.title: F3 Mission Project Manager
vacancies.assessment: Broad spacecraft-development relevance but substantial project-management and seniority stretch.

vacancies.title: Secure Connectivity Low TRL Technology Development Coordinator
vacancies.assessment: Interesting early-stage technology maturation and validation exposure at ESA, but strongly telecom-oriented and senior in expected experience.

vacancies.title: Secure Connectivity 5G NTN End-to-End System and Validation Lead Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA validation role, but highly specialized in 5G NTN and secure-connectivity systems rather than mechanical engineering.

vacancies.title: D2D 5G/6G Network Lead Mission Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESA and verification-relevant, but predominantly telecom/5G specialist work.

vacancies.title: Phoenix Study Manager
vacancies.assessment: Broad early mission/system design is relevant to a generalist profile, but Study Manager seniority is a significant stretch.

vacancies.title: Commercialization Engineer
vacancies.assessment: ESTEC role requiring a technical MSc and combining technology assessment, industry interaction and ESA programme support. Less hardware-focused than your target path, but a legitimate generalist ESTEC route; 4+ years consulting/project experience is the main stretch.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Relevant mechanical space-hardware role focused on Ariane 6 structures; stronger FEMAP/NASTRAN and structural-analysis experience would improve competitiveness.

vacancies.title: Project Manager
vacancies.assessment: Strong secondary-space opportunity at Airbus Netherlands. The role leads 5–15 people across projects in Solar Arrays, Launcher Structures, Instruments & Systems and asks for a technical HBO/academic degree plus 2–5+ years as a project lead/manager. Main gap is proving formal project-lead ownership, but the technical and industrial background is relevant.

vacancies.title: Ground Control Segment Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Current ESTEC role with systems/verification exposure, but ground-control software and operations are outside the strongest mechanical profile.

vacancies.title: End-to-End Mission Performance Engineers (2 positions)
vacancies.assessment: Relevant verification and simulator work at ESTEC; meaningful software/optical-performance stretch, but worth tracking under high-recall strategy.

vacancies.title: PA and Safety Support Engineer
vacancies.assessment: PA/Safety exposure is relevant, but this role asks for 10 years space-sector experience including 5 years in PA/QA.

vacancies.title: Satcom New Concepts Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Direct ESTEC route but strongly specialized in SATCOM user/ground-segment technologies; outside the core mechanical profile.

vacancies.title: EMC Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Spacecraft verification/testing at ESTEC is attractive, but the role is strongly electrical/EMC specialized and asks for dedicated EMC experience.

vacancies.title: System Engineer – Quantum Technologies
vacancies.assessment: Interesting ESA systems exposure, but quantum communications and prior space-systems experience make this a substantial domain stretch.

vacancies.title: Clean Space & Safety Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Mechanical-engineering degree is relevant and the role includes technology development, systems engineering and Clean Space activities. Main stretch is prior space experience plus Zero Debris/LCA expertise.

vacancies.title: Technical Engineering Manager Vibration Acoustic
vacancies.assessment: Excellent technical subject match and direct ESTEC Test Centre exposure, but clearly a senior leadership role requiring several years of spacecraft mechanical-test experience.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Test Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Excellent technical match, but Serco's official careers page now states that the position has been filled.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Engineer - Medior
vacancies.assessment: Excellent technical match: next-generation spacecraft mechanical structures, requirements-to-design ownership, manufacturing and qualification. Four years of complex mechanical-design experience is the main formal stretch, but your broader engineering background makes this highly worth applying to.

vacancies.title: Systems AIT Engineer - Medior
vacancies.assessment: Strong spacecraft-hardware route combining AIT planning, hands-on integration, testing, traceability and anomaly resolution. Good fit for your practical/mechanical background without being merely a technician role.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Engineer - Medior/Senior
vacancies.assessment: Very relevant design/FEM/qualification work on satellite launch hardware and deployers. The explicit 5+ years complex-design experience and Nastran requirement make it a meaningful stretch, but the subject matter is strongly aligned.

vacancies.title: Mechanical Engineer - Senior
vacancies.assessment: Strong technical content including requirements-driven mechanical design, verification and thermal-related interfaces. The 5+ years after graduation plus mentoring/technical-ownership expectations make this clearly senior, but it is useful as a stretch application and career benchmark.

vacancies.title: Product Assurance Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Relevant to your ESA Academy PA exposure and hardware background, with design reviews, FMEA, NCRs and environmental-test planning. Main gap is the stated minimum two years in a dedicated space-quality role.

vacancies.title: Senior AOCS Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Relevant to a mechatronics/control-oriented generalist: AOCS algorithms, sensors, actuators, mission implementation and performance verification. However, the role is explicitly senior and expects substantial dedicated AOCS experience.

vacancies.title: Space Systems Engineer - Senior
vacancies.assessment: Broad spacecraft systems work spanning feasibility studies, requirements, system design and mission analysis fits a mechanical generalist well, but the senior experience level is a substantial stretch.

vacancies.title: SAIT Software Engineer
vacancies.assessment: Directly supports satellite AIT and automated verification, but the actual role is primarily software ownership and development rather than mechanical or hardware engineering. Included for high recall because of the strong satellite-test context.

vacancies.title: Labs and Test Facilities Manager
vacancies.assessment: Strong practical test-facility route: cleanrooms, environmental test equipment, calibration, test setup development and support to project test execution. Your industrial hardware background is relevant, although the role is more facilities/operations coordination than spacecraft design and formally targets BEng/HBO with 3–5 years experience.
